Keep the original tower visible and original separate coaster curves. Empty boats, no people along opposite bank. Plain red hulls without theme figures. Do not rearrange the park into a panoramic aerial view.
Lighting: beautiful warm late afternoon summer sunlight, realistic blue sky, lush green trees with irregular natural foliage, delicate physical reflections and small irregular ripples. Balanced photographic contrast, detailed shade and realistic sunlit edges.
